comment: Mary seems nice initially, and you think you're doing fine because she keeps praising your work and claiming it's good, till she gives you a C for drafts. She never looks at you, and her class is very very boring. Her voice is monotonous and she thinks swearing makes you cool. Sorry  Mary, nothing will make you cool
I enjoyed this class and it taught me a lot.  It pretty easy to do well if you hand in your work. Also, Mary is always willing to set up a meeting to help you if you need it
Great prof.  She really tries her hardest to get students to understand.  My writing did improve.  I recommend her.

Mary is a pretty cool prof. and i liked her class simply because it was fun to hear what crazy line would come out of her mouth next. if you want to open up and learn new writing skills you can grasp some new techniques. not too hard. assignments are annoying but that would happen with any expos class
Just don't take her class. Nice lady with great intentions, but just don't do it.

Thomas SUCKS! Her assignments are big + huge. The instructions are vague and broad at best. My writing ability has NOT improved cuz of having her as a professor. The writing process she teaches does NOT work in college cuz it is too detailed w/ all this pre-planning stuff, Im never going to have the time to do all this. Save yourself the trouble.

She's a nice lady even though she seems like she just roled out of bed every class and is very unclear in her expectations for the class.  Not well organized or structured enough for my taste.  Ended up with a B+ in the class.

This class was a pain in general. I really like Mary as a person - she tries to be as helpful as possible and makes herself available outside of class, but her assignments are confusing, the syllabus is hard to follow, and you can't predict what type of grade you're going to get.
This teacher sux.  She never looks at you when she talks and gives everyone a C

Kind of a weird lady. Only three papers to write all semester. But she spreads them out. Her syllabus/assignment dates are confusing. You finish your final paper one week, then go back to your first paper the next. Builds up you confidence then gives you less than par grades. Hard to figure out.

Mary provides a great excape from the normal class structure at Richmond.  Her sarcasm and blunt comments are sometimes awkward but make the class interesting and edgy.  While she is very willing to help you with assignments, her comments and requirements are not always clear.
she was helpful whenever I went to talk to her, but she was pretty unclear about what she wanted turned in. You definatly need to put in alot of work to get a good grade.

She does not let you know how your grade will turn out till you see it on bannerweb.  Super nice lady, but unclear about what she expects from her papers.  If you want to slack off for a semester take her, but don't count on an easy A, like she used to be...

Mary was helpful and funny, but leads you into thinking your grade will be much better than it ends up being. Even if you put in alot of effort, she does not take that into consideration. Class time is a waste and very boring.
Mary is a hard grader, but your writing will imporve if you put in the work.  Sardonic humor makes class interesting.
